verdict.sentence: The threshold asks 58.82 hours a day; the channels produce 0.814. With both format levers at their documented levels it would be 2.466. To reach the threshold at a 4% click rate and the measured watch time, YouTube would have to serve 8,350 impressions a day where it serves 350. Impressions are chosen by YouTube's recommendation system from how viewers respond, so that is the honest distance: it is reach, not metadata.
